title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $140 on Eufy 11S Max
excerpt: It's a compact and affordable option.
content_html:
SAVE $140: As of Sept. 9, the Eufy 11S Max is on sale for $139.99 at Amazon. That's a 50% discount on the list price.

Credit: Eufy

$139.99 at Amazon
$279.99 Save $140

Robot vacuums have come a long way in recent years, with models now available at a range of prices and with features to suit different homes. If you've been considering getting one, you don't necessarily have to spend a lot to get a model that handles everyday vacuuming for you. In fact, as of Sept. 9, you can get a great model for just $139.99. Meet the Eufy 11S Max. Currently on sale, you'll save $140 on this Eufy robot vacuum, which is also its best price so far this year.

It's just 2.85 inches tall, so this robot vacuum has no problem getting into those awkward spaces beneath furniture that are difficult to reach with a standard vacuum or brush. Its battery lasts for up to 100 minutes on hardwood floors, while BoostIQ Technology automatically adjusts the suction power to suit the surface within 1.5 seconds.

An infrared sensor helps the robot navigate around obstacles, and drop sensors help it avoid falling from edges or down stairs. When it needs more power, it can also automatically return to its charging base.
